description: Deactivates a feed for an explicit user request to interrupt its subscription access, without deleting events or resetting editing windows. User approval of that access interruption is required. A counted active feed releases its allowance slot. publication.status reports calendar-file preparation, not subscription access. distribution_ready reports subscription availability at the returned revision; availability may change afterward. Scope is limited to the connected account’s Smart Calendars AI feeds. No mailbox access, source-document retrieval, automatic source monitoring, scheduled PDF checks or document refresh is provided. Structured schedule content is supplied explicitly by the caller. Result links: subscription_open_url is the exact HTTPS handoff to the default calendar app via webcal; subscription_options_url provides Apple/default, Google, Outlook and copy-link choices; subscription_url is the copyable HTTPS calendar-file fallback; manage_url opens the feed dashboard. URL hosts, paths and tokens identify the returned resource and are not interchangeable. A filtered_subscription has its own links for that selection; top-level links remain unfiltered. Subscription access requires distribution_ready=true. Opening a link does not confirm a subscription; confirmation occurs in the user’s calendar app.

expected_revision.description: Last read feed revision; prevents overwriting concurrent edits.

feed_id.description: Identity of the selected calendar, as returned in feed results.

request_id.description: Opaque, non-personal idempotency key for this operation. Identical retries retain the same key and payload to prevent duplicate changes. User identifiers, chat/session IDs, telemetry and personal data are outside this field’s scope.

name: deactivate_feed
title: Deactivate a calendar
